scripts.title: BloxAgent Custom AI Dev MOBILE SUPPORT
scripts.features:
Agentic AI In-Game: Runs a full AI agent inside any live Roblox game. Give it a task in plain English and it carries it out — reading the game, writing and running Luau, editing scripts, and reporting back when done.

Multi-Provider Support: Bring your own model. Works with Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Venice AI, and Zhipu GLM out of the box. Switch providers and models from a dropdown, or fetch the live model list straight from your provider's API.

Code Execution: The agent writes and runs real Luau on demand and reads back prints, return values, warnings, and errors, with full executor access.

Background Processes: Run continuous scripts without blocking the chat. Get a process ID back, then list, read output, and kill them individually or all at once.

Game Inspection: Pulls PlaceId, GameId, server JobId, your character state, and the workspace tree so the agent orients itself before acting.

Instance Finder: Search the whole game by name and get back full paths, class names, and positions for parts and models.

Script Codebase Tools: List every Script, LocalScript, and ModuleScript with full paths. Read source where the decompiler allows, edit with an automatic line diff, and revert the last edit from a snapshot.

Subagents: Fan big jobs out across multiple independent subagents running in parallel, then collect each result by ID.

Built-In Executor: A clean, Solara-style script editor in its own draggable window. Multiple tabs, line-number gutter, Lua syntax highlighting, run button, and autosave so scripts survive between sessions.

Agent-Executor Collaboration: The AI can see your open tabs, read what you're working on, rewrite a tab with a live diff, open new tabs with starter code, and run any tab to test it.

scripts.script:
-- 🚀 Full Auto Tycoon + Bank + Auto Delete StoreMenu
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.4

print("🚀 Full Auto Tycoon Started (Buttons + Bank + Anti-StoreMenu)...")

local function triggerTouch(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local touchInterest = part:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest")
    if not touchInterest then return false end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return false end
    
    firetouchinterest(root, part, 0)
    task.wait(0.03)
    firetouchinterest(root, part, 1)
    return true
end

local function deleteStoreMenus()
    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then return end
    
    for _, gui in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if gui.Name == "StoreMenu" then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function autoCollect()
    local tycoonsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
    if not tycoonsFolder then return end
    
    local tycoon = tycoonsFolder:FindFirstChild("GamerZomba_123 Tycoon")
    if not tycoon then return end
    
    local triggered = 0
    
    -- Trigger Buttons
    local buttonsFolder = tycoon:FindFirstChild("Buttons", true)
    if buttonsFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(buttonsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                if triggerTouch(obj) then
                    triggered += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Trigger Bank
    local modelsFolder = tycoon:FindFirstChild("Models", true)
    if modelsFolder then
        local bank = modelsFolder:FindFirstChild("Bank")
        if bank then
            local zonePart = bank:FindFirstChild("ZonePart")
            if zonePart and triggerTouch(zonePart) then
                triggered += 1
            end
        end
    end
    
    if triggered > 0 then
        print("🔄 Triggered " .. triggered .. " things")
    end
end

-- Main loop
while true do
    autoCollect()
    deleteStoreMenus()     -- Auto delete StoreMenu every loop
    task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
end

local hrp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local openTrade = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameEvents.OpenTradeMenu
game:GetService("GuiService"):SetGameplayPausedNotificationEnabled(false)


while task.wait(0.2) do
hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

openTrade:FireServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish
)

task.wait(0.2)

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.PurchaseGoods:InvokeServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish,
    "Dried Fish",
    3
)
task.wait(0.2)



hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

openTrade:FireServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish
)

task.wait(0.2)
local sellEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.SellGoods
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 3)
end)
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 2)
end)
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 1)
end)
end
